free_tier.stated: 200 MB per file on catbox.moe, no total quota. Anonymous or free account. Anonymous files live until 2 years of inactivity; files tied to an account are permanent. Litterbox (sister service) takes 1 GB but expires in 1h-3d by choice.

retention.stated: Anonymous files live until 2 years of inactivity; files tied to an account are permanent

egress.terms: free direct GET from files.catbox.moe, no metering, range requests supported.

record.tooling: https://catbox.moe/user/api.php multipart (reqtype=fileupload, fileToUpload=@f) returns a bare URL. Official ShareX config, Chrome and Firefox extensions; many community Python/Node/Go/Rust libs. No rclone backend, no account API for listing.
record.chaining: Allows unlimited anonymous uploads at 200 MB per file. Free registered accounts provide permanent retention rather than 2-year idle expiration.
record.limits_note: 200 MB/file (GIF 20 MB); anonymous retention is inactivity-based; albums 500 files; .exe/.scr/.cpl/.doc*/.jar blocked; single-operator service.
record.reliability_note: Uploads return a valid files.catbox.moe URL, but download testing on 2026-10-21 returned HTTP 200 with Content-Length: 0 and empty bodies across multiple files, despite Accept-Ranges headers.

evidence.proved: 'Anonymously uploaded files are kept until they have 2 years of inactivity ... Uploads associated with user accounts are permanent'
probe: curl -F reqtype=fileupload -F fileToUpload=@ct.txt -> https://files.catbox.moe/affeka.txt; then GET -> HTTP 200, bytes=0 (repeated 3x, incl. 1.2 MB binary and 5 MB binary)

record.notes: 200 MB per file on catbox.moe, no total quota. Anonymous or free account. Anonymous files live until 2 years of inactivity; files tied to an account are permanent. Litterbox (sister service) takes 1 GB but expires in 1h-3d by choice.

record.chaining: a free anonymous object host that needs no account; it composes as a relay or a small-object store, not as an archive
